selected_story_lens: A tiny OTP countdown turns into a two-person panic system that works because both people join the same ridiculous pressure.
selector_verdict: OTP wins because it has visible pressure, shared failure, side-by-side repair, and a taggable final line without perfect-husband rescue.

stage_scene_gate.action: A harmless 30-second OTP starts a tiny home mission.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Aachu types fast while Zuv reads too calmly, then both freeze over one unclear digit.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Their eye-lines move between the two phones and each other, proving shared pressure.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Two phones move closer together; his finger tracks digits, her thumb freezes, then both hands reset side by side.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The expired screen creates a deadpan pause before the resend.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The first attempt fails, forcing them into closer teamwork.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The ordinary task becomes a funny relationship proof: two people panicking correctly.
